name: benchmark
description: Measures how fast this MyNOS is, in about half a minute: the processor (OCaml), the system (a system call, IPC round trips, thread switches, starting a program, files), the network. Each measure in its unit, a score per group and a total (1000: MyNOS in QEMU with KVM on the reference PC; more is faster), and the change since the last run.

parameters.groups: the groups to measure, among cpu, system, net; or all
